title: Add a benchmark system
body: First, I'd like to say I'm loving your aim trainer! It really is much more performant than KovaaK's. However, one of the features I need is benchmarks, along with higher scenario variety/quality (I made an issue to add the Viscose Benchmarks in the Bundles repository).
